name: Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Ltd deals in Agri trading and investment 
in securities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SGEL operates in the business of purchasing, storing, warehousing, logistics, transportation, and trading various types of agro commodities and other non-agro commodities, in addition to trading in shares and securities. Currently, the company has started investing in the capital market for the long term and is looking for other business opportunities beyond its commodity business.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.26% over last 3 years.
